title: Participating Practice Manual — Orthodontic Records Already Paid Under the Patient's Dental PPO Plan
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders and Dental PPO Plans: records taken by the orthodontist now treating the patient.**

Orthodontic records are paid inside the case benefit. Records that the orthodontist now treating the patient took, and that were paid under the patient's own Dental PPO Plans enrollment, are therefore not paid a second time in the first carried payment.

The **records lines** are the paid claim lines of that dental enrollment that meet both conditions:

- billed under the participation agreement named on the latest transfer entry;
- dated (date of service) fewer than 6 whole calendar months before today.

What comes off the carried benefit:

| Records lines found | Amount that comes off the carried benefit |
|---|---|
| a comprehensive oral evaluation line (code D0150) and a panoramic image line (code D0330) | the plan payments of all those evaluation and panoramic lines |
| a panoramic image line (D0330) but no evaluation line (D0150) | the plan payments of the panoramic lines |
| an evaluation line (D0150) only, or neither | nothing |
| any lines, when the latest transfer entry names no agreement | nothing |

## The 6-month window

A calendar month counts as whole only when today's day of the month is on or after the day of the month of the date of service. A line counts while fewer than 6 such whole months have passed.

*Hypothetical boundary, today being 18 October:*

- a line dated 19 April has 5 whole months behind it and is inside the window;
- a line dated 18 April has 6 and is outside it.

*Hypothetical figures:* within the window, the dental plan paid 61.00 on a D0150 line and 88.00 on a D0330 line under the new orthodontist's agreement, so 149.00 comes off the carried benefit. Had only the D0330 line been paid, 88.00 would come off.
